## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Nicky's Cafe & Fine Pastries?
No. 5/763, Sabari Salai, Madipakkam, Chennai 600 091.

### What facilities does Nicky's Cafe & Fine Pastries have?
Customised cakes, Wedding cakes, Birthday cakes, Photosheet cakes, Pastries & cheesecakes, Sandwiches & coffee, Party menu, Office events & bulk orders, Delivery & pickup, Gift cards.

### Where are your cafes?
Madipakkam, Velachery (Palladium Mall), Egattur, Navalur and Kottivakkam.

### What are your support hours?
Our customer support team is available Monday to Sunday, 10 AM to 7 PM.

### Do you cater office events and parties?
Yes. Our party menu covers birthday parties, office events and customised bulk orders.

### How do I order a cake from Nicky's Cafe & Fine Pastries?
Pick your date in the order section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 73053 29826. Delivery and pickup are both available.
